newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline gains $2, supported by crude contango.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline gains $2, supported by crude contango.

text.p: NWE gasoline was perkier on Friday with prices boosted $2 or so.
"Crude's contango is helping and it's looking bullish in the near term," said one dealer.

Traders said as high as $207 was bid for first half June Rotterdam eurograde barge material while offers were around the $208 level. Swaps were also stronger, but to a lesser degree, with June pegged around $207. A hefty backwardation into July of $6 remains, traders said.
Trans-atlantic arbitrage opportunities were seen developing for 30,000 tonne cargoes and over.
"There is an ex-UK cargo that is on offer which could well go Stateside," said one trader.

The date of the UK budget is to be announced on Monday June 2, which suggests a late June early July platform for the country's new chancellor of the exchequer (finance minister) Gordon Brown rather than the June 10 date some traders had been anticipating.
The market had been building stocks ahead of an expected rise in gasoline excise.
